integrity: Cofactor polynomial certificates were constructed with exact integer arithmetic from exhaustively generated graph orbits; the rational path witness and verification program are embedded.
limitations: Finite exact enumeration covers all connected unweighted simple graphs through six vertices; a seven-vertex path is the sharp witness. No weighted/directed/greater-order classification, full seven-path timestep interval, or independent validation is claimed. A plausibly related 2010 Padé paper was inaccessible in full text.
title: Seven vertices are sharp for positivity loss of the cubic inverse-Taylor heat step
